market_summary: Anthropic filed its public S-1 on Monday for a Nasdaq listing as ANT. Reports put the valuation at $1.5-2T, with listing expected mid-November. Lula won Brazil's runoff 51.8% to 48.2%, Flavio Bolsonaro has not conceded, and Brazil ADRs fell 10-29% premarket. US stocks opened about 0.5% higher, led by chips, and Brent fell about 5% to near $110 after Trump ruled out an immediate strike on Iran. The 10-year yield is flat near 4.99%. Asia was mixed on Monday: Nikkei -0.8%, Kospi -1.5%, Hang Seng +0.5%. Futures price about 91% for a Fed hold this week but about 80% for a hike in December. Next: Robinhood Q3 Wed ~7am AEDT, Enphase Q3 Wed ~7:30am AEDT, Alphabet Q3 Thu ~7:30am AEDT, Fed decision Thu 5am AEDT, Amazon/Axos/Rocket Fri ~8am AEDT.

AMZN.reason: Up 0.3% Monday. Anthropic's IPO filing should give its Anthropic stake a public mark. Q3 Thu US (Fri ~8am AEDT); AWS growth and capex are the test.

AXOS.reason: Up 0.8% Monday. No new news. Fiscal Q1 Thu US (Fri ~8am AEDT); watch loan growth and margin.

BABA.reason: Flat Monday, up 0.3%. No new news since the SAMR item; Hang Seng +0.5%. Wait for the November quarter print.

ENPH.reason: Down 3% Monday ahead of Q3 Tue US close (Wed ~7:30am AEDT). Q4 guide and the loss of the US tax credit are the swing factors.

FIGR.reason: Down 1% Monday, no new news. Earnings date unchanged.

GOOGL.reason: Flat Monday. Anthropic's IPO should give Google's stake a public mark. Q3 Wed US (Thu ~7:30am AEDT); Cloud growth vs capex decides it.

LDI.reason: Down 3% Monday on no news. Yields flat near 5% still weigh on mortgage volume.

META.reason: Down 1% Monday after launching a $35B stock sale (about 2% dilution) for AI, with $60B more from 2027. Shareholders now fund the capex; watch.

MRVL.reason: Up 1% Monday with chips. No company news.

MU.reason: Up 3% Monday. Taoyuan union talks are due Oct 27 Taiwan, and the dispute is unresolved after the 24-hour strike. SK Hynix reports Oct 28.

NFLX.reason: Down 1% Monday, near its 52-week low and down 7% since Oct 19 after the ad forecast cut. No new catalyst.

NVDA.reason: Up 2% Monday after three down weeks. Anthropic's S-1 commits about $3.1B a month to Nvidia-GPU compute; neocloud credit stress is the risk.

RKT.reason: Down 0.5% Monday, no news. Q3 Thu US (Fri ~8am AEDT); with the 10-year near 5%, origination volume is the watch item.

TSM.reason: Up 1% Monday with chips. No new company news.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender. The last company-set mark is the $159B February tender. Mark unchanged.

OPENAI.reason: The $30B raise at a $1.25T valuation is still unclosed, with signatures sought this week. Anthropic's IPO sets a public comparable. Mark unchanged.

headlines: Anthropic filed its public S-1 for a Nasdaq listing as ANT; H1 revenue $16.3B, valuation talk $1.5-2T.
Meta launched a $35B stock sale to fund AI, about 2% dilution, with $60B more planned from 2027.
Lula won Brazil's runoff 51.8% to 48.2%; Brazil ADRs fell 10-29% premarket and MercadoLibre about 12%.
Chips led Monday's open: Micron up 3%, Nvidia 2%; Brent down 5% near $110 as Iran strike fears eased.
Next, AEDT: Celestica Tue ~7am; Robinhood and Enphase Wed ~7am; Fed Thu 5am; Alphabet Thu ~7:30am.
